answer:
Simulation of a 2D compressible supersonic jet (Mach 2.0) discharging from a wall-bounded nozzle into a larger quiescent domain, solved with OpenFOAM using rhoCentralFoam.
Solver: rhoCentralFoam (central-difference density-based scheme suited for high-Mach shock-capturing).
Thermophysical model in constant/thermophysicalProperties: hePsiThermo with type pureMixture, equationOfState perfectGas, transport sutherland.
Gas properties for air: molecular weight W = 0.0289644 kg/mol, Cv = 717.5 J/(kg K), Cp = 1004.5 J/(kg K).
Inlet total pressure 101325 Pa, static temperature 300 K, velocity (686, 0, 0) m/s corresponding to Mach 2.0.
Domain geometry: single rectangular block spanning x in [0, 0.12] m, y in [0, 0.06] m, z in [0, 0.001] m.
z-direction contains exactly one cell; frontAndBack patch set to type empty in blockMeshDict and in 0 boundary field.
Nozzle exit height H = 0.02 m; nozzle inlet spans y from 0 to 0.02 m at the x = 0 plane.
Bottom boundary y = 0 for all x: patch type wall, boundaryCondition noSlip for U, fixedValue 0 for p_rgh (or zeroGradient for p in rhoCentralFoam), zeroGradient for T.
Top boundary y = 0.06 m for all x: patch type patch (far-field), boundaryConditions waveTransmissive for p and T, zeroGradient for U.
Outlet boundary x = 0.12 m for all y: patch type patch, boundaryConditions waveTransmissive for p and T, zeroGradient for U.
Nozzle inlet patch at x = 0, y in [0, 0.02] m: patch type patch, boundaryConditions fixedValue U = (686,0,0), fixedValue p = 101325, fixedValue T = 300.
Nozzle lip / solid wall at x = 0, y in [0.02, 0.06] m: patch type wall, boundaryConditions noSlip for U, zeroGradient for p, zeroGradient for T.
blockMeshDict vertex coordinates: vertex(0) = (0,0,0), vertex(1) = (0.12,0,0), vertex(2) = (0.12,0.06,0), vertex(3) = (0,0.06,0), vertex(4) = (0,0,0.001), vertex(5) = (0.12,0,0.001), vertex(6) = (0.12,0.06,0.001), vertex(7) = (0,0.06,0.001).
blockMeshDict cells: approximately 480 in x, 240 in y, 1 in z (total ~115,200 cells).
Grading in x: geometric progression with expansion ratio 1.005 starting from the nozzle exit (x=0) to coarsen toward outlet; alternatively uniform if simpler first-pass desired.
Grading in y: geometric progression with expansion ratio 1.05 anchored at y=0 (nozzle lip / shear layer region) to refine the nozzle-exit shear layer and the wall boundary layer.
Grading in z: uniform (single cell, irrelevant).
blockMeshDict boundary list: left (x=0) split into two patches (inlet_y0_to_y2, lip_y2_to_y6) or a single patch refined via internalFace; right (x=0.12) = outlet; bottom (y=0) = wall_bottom; top (y=0.06) = farfield_top; frontAndBack (z) = empty.
If blockMesh single-block topology does not allow splitting the x=0 face into two named patches, use a two-block decomposition: block0 covers x in [0,0.005] y in [0,0.02] (nozzle exit throat, finer mesh, faces named nozzle_inlet and nozzle_lip), block1 covers the remainder x in [0.005,0.12] y in [0,0.06] (far-field jet region). Adjust vertex and block definitions accordingly.
controlDict: application rhoCentralFoam; timeStep 2e-7 s (CFL ~0.5 for 686 m/s with dx ~ 2.5e-4 m at nozzle exit); endTime 1.0e-3 s (approximately 1.4 ms physical, covering multiple nozzle-height flow-throughs); writeInterval chosen for visualization (e.g., every 500 or 1000 steps).
fvSchemes: divScheme for rhoU and rhoE set to vanLeerTVD or localEulerdTVD; grad schemes leastSquares; ddt Euler or backward (backward preferred after transient); interpolation linear.
fvSolution: solver for p (or no pressure Poisson since rhoCentralFoam is explicit; only rhoU and rhoE need explicit update). No PIMPLE loop required; time-loop is explicit. Set relaxationFactors not applicable; ensure adjustTimeStep yes with maxCo 0.5 and maxDeltaT 2e-7.
Initial fields in 0/: U uniform (0,0,0) or (686,0,0) in nozzle region and (0,0,0) elsewhere; p uniform 101325 Pa; T uniform 300 K; rho derived from perfect gas law p/(RT).
The user shall review the blockMeshDict vertex coordinates, cell counts, grading parameters, patch naming, and all boundary condition file entries before execution. Any deviation from H=0.02 m, non-symmetric wall-bounded topology, rhoCentralFoam, hePsiThermo/perfectGas/sutherland, or the specified BC types is not permitted without explicit user confirmation.
